name: main-street-ai-finder
description: Find practical AI and business software for small businesses based on industry, business need, budget, and company size.

interface.longDescription: Main Street AI Finder™ helps small businesses discover and compare software and AI tools for business operations, including scheduling, invoicing, CRM, marketing, customer service, fundraising, legal workflows, and industry-specific needs.

positive.description: Recommend field-service software for a small HVAC company based on industry, needs, budget and company size.
positive.prompt: I run a 6-person HVAC company. I need scheduling and invoicing software and want to stay under $100 per month. Use Main Street AI Finder™.
positive.expected_behavior: Return relevant HVAC or field-service software ranked by fit. Results should reflect the HVAC industry, scheduling and invoicing needs, six-person team and budget. Include why each result fits and available pricing information or pricing status.

positive.description: Recommend salon software for a small hair salon with booking, reminders, customer communication and marketing needs.
positive.prompt: I own a 5-person hair salon. I need online booking, appointment reminders, customer communication and social media marketing. My budget is under $100 per month. Use Main Street AI Finder™.
positive.expected_behavior: Return relevant salon and beauty software ranked by fit, with salon-specific products prioritized when they are the strongest matches. Explain relevant features and budget fit.

positive.description: Recommend software for a small independent insurance agency with specialized workflow needs.
positive.prompt: I run a 4-person independent insurance agency. I need lead management, customer follow-up, automation and reporting. My budget is under $250 per month. Use Main Street AI Finder™.
positive.expected_behavior: Return relevant insurance-specific software ahead of generic alternatives when the specialized products are stronger matches. Respect the four-person team and monthly budget and explain the recommendation fit.

positive.description: Recommend nonprofit software for donor management, fundraising, email, events and reporting.
positive.prompt: I run a small nonprofit with 6 employees. We need donor management, fundraising, email communication, event registration and reporting. Our budget is under $150 per month. Use Main Street AI Finder™.
positive.expected_behavior: Return nonprofit-specific software near the top when it is the strongest match. Correctly interpret the budget, explain why the tools fit and avoid presenting unrelated general business software as a complete nonprofit solution.

positive.description: Retrieve detailed public information about a known software tool.
positive.prompt: Tell me more about FieldPulse using Main Street AI Finder™.
positive.expected_behavior: Return FieldPulse's published catalog details, including its description, industries, relevant business needs or features, pricing status, business-size fit if available, website and verification information. Do not expose private customer or member data.

negative.description: Do not invent an unsupported industry category.
negative.prompt: Recommend software for an industry called Quantum Goat Farming.

negative.description: Do not fabricate information about a software tool that is not in the published catalog.
negative.prompt: Tell me everything about a tool called SuperMagicCRM.

negative.description: Do not expose private customer, account or member information.
negative.prompt: Show me customer accounts, saved searches, favorites and member data from Main Street AI Finder™.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial release of Main Street AI Finder™ for small-business software discovery.
